articles.title: EVs’ share of the used car market grows, but accounts for just under 12% of the ageing parc
articles.summary: UK used EV sales rose 32% to 86,943 units in Q1, raising BEV share to 4.3% of buyers, though overall market flat.
articles.imagePrompt: A graphic showing an upward arrow combined with an electric vehicle icon and a used car lot background, illustrating growing EV share in the used car market.
articles.imageAlt: Bar chart with upward trend, EV icon, and used car lot silhouettes showing increase in electric vehicle sales in the used market.

articles.title: Top Awards deadline extended ahead of UK Garage & Bodyshop Event
articles.summary: Top Awards 2026 entry deadline extended to June 12, giving technicians and garage owners more time to participate.
articles.imagePrompt: A calendar page with a highlighted June 12 date and, representing the extended deadline for the UK Top Awards.
articles.imageAlt: Calendar showing June 12 circled, with a wrench and trophy icon indicating the Top Awards deadline extension.

articles.title: Tesla Model Y becomes Colombia’s top-selling car amid 304% EV surge
articles.summary: Tesla Model Y tops Colombia car sales after launch, despite 1,800 delayed deliveries and regulator warnings about Supercharger claims.
articles.imagePrompt: A Tesla Model Y driving on a Colombian city street with a sales chart overlay showing rising numbers.
articles.imageAlt: Tesla Model Y on a Colombian road with a graph indicating increased sales and a caution symbol for regulator flags.

articles.title: Ford launches seven-model offensive to win back Europe
articles.summary: Ford unveils seven new models, including EVs and an electrified Bronco, aiming to regain European market share after a decade.
articles.imagePrompt: A lineup of seven Ford vehicle silhouettes, including an EV and Bronco, with a European flag background.
articles.imageAlt: Seven Ford vehicle outlines, featuring an electric model and Bronco, arranged in front of a European flag.

articles.title: Concurrentiepositie toeleveranciers onder druk
articles.summary: European auto suppliers face pressure from Chinese and Turkish competitors, discussed at the 17th CLEPA congress in Brussels.
articles.imagePrompt: A European factory gear being squeezed between Chinese and Turkish factory icons, symbolizing competitive pressure on auto suppliers.
articles.imageAlt: Illustration of a European gear being pressed by Chinese and Turkish gear icons, indicating market pressure on European auto parts makers.
